title: Kharis
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Heroes of the Realm characters)

paragraphs.text: Kharis is a dragon wizard from an unknown plane that was seen through the Eyes of a Beholder .

The character of Kharis was created by Wizards of the Coast for a celebration card as part of the 2018 Heroes of the Realm program. He appears to be a large golden dragon that breathes fire. He is viewed through the Eyes of a Beholder .
